payload.reason: The evidence indicates that while traditional dialogue systems often rely on handcrafted rules, there is a movement towards using end-to-end neural models and transfer learning methods. This suggests that off-the-shelf NLP systems are being integrated into the development of conversational assistants, particularly in re-implementing components of these systems.

claims.text: Many industrially deployed dialogue systems still use handcrafted rules, but there is a trend towards end-to-end neural models and transfer learning methods.
The authors re-implemented components of their conversational assistant using deep learning methods, indicating the use of advanced NLP techniques.
